Almost there. Cersier's tree is...
Almost there. Cersier's tree is...\nWhoa?!
There's a big cherry tree. Looks like it's in full\nbloom but when you look closer, huge crystals are\nsticking to its root and trunk.
W-What's that?!\nThe situation looks a bit different from the\ncherry tree we handled the last time.
No!! Cersier!!
Hey, what's going on??\nI don't understand anything.\nPlease, someone explain this.
What happened?\nWho did such a thing to my sister's tree...
I have no idea... The crystal began to cover up\nthe trunk before I noticed... I managed to bloom\nbut I got weak and it's hard to talk by telepathy.
A-Anyway, let's use Parasiverto.\nJust step back...
W-What?!
What are you doing here?!\nAre you trying to stop us again?!\nThen, I won't forgive you!!
We must deal with it before removing the crystals!\nFine, I'll assist you. Let's finish in a flash!!
Ug... Ugh... I won't let you touch my kins...\nGo... my clones...\nCrush the humans...
Gosh... No time to breathe, huh?!
Whoa?! Don't! Hey!
Adventurer! Watch out!!
Whoa! What's goin' on?!
What? What's happening?!
There are two familiar people...\nThey're Tenert and Libera of Support Caravan for\nAdventurers.
Oh? You're...
Whoa?! It's been a while! What are you doing?!\nWell, I can tell the situation isn't normal...
Anyway. let's talk after finishing all this!\nLet's begin, Libera!!
Phew, we managed to defeat it...
What's that look on your face? ...How did you get\nto here, you ask? Well, we went to the venue to\nenjoy Hanami again while it's in full bloom and...
Then, I found Virgo's note on the ground and a\nmagic stone that shows the destination.\nAnd it led us to here.
So, what's going on here?
You told her that the monsters appeared when Virgo\ntried to spray Parasiverto to remove the unknown\ncrystals from the tree of Sherry's sister.
...A sister of the tree spirit that we saved the\nlast time?! Hmm... I knew it was a mysterious\nworld but...
A spirit of Sakura tree has a sister and the world\nis divided into the regions of daylight and night.\nSounds way more mysterious.
By the way, Virgo...\nI was wondering why he didn't come back but\nhe's arrived already, huh?
Whoa?! Virgo?!
Well, I know he won't die but...\nWe can't stand and watch this...\nHey, can you give us a hand?
...Oh, great!\nShould be easy for us to deal with the monsters.\nCome on, Libera.
Okay. I also can't wait to see the Yozakura\nblooming! Let's cover Virgo!
Alright! Keep your guard up, guys!!\n
Hey! Heh heh, shame on me...\nI was gonna take them down alone but...\nLook at me...
Stay there, Virgo!\nAdventurer! Let's take them down with us!
Yea, you made it!\nI was wondering what will become of me but\nyou saved my life. Thanks...
Okay, let's head back to the Yozakura tree.\nThere's no time to lose...
Welcome back! I'm glad to see Virgo is safe.\nI saw him fighting a horrible monster, so I was\nworried about him. I'm so relieved...
Well, your combat skill is really amazing that\nyou've defeated such monsters...
Hey, Virgo?\nWhy don't you say it looking at us?
It's not only the adventurer who saved you from\ndanger, you know? Well, fine.\nYou owe me and Libera one.
Aww, not again...\nAnyway, it took so long but let's remove the\ncrystals with this Parasiverto.
How nice of you to help me even though you can't\nsee me... I really apprecia... Ugh...
Sis, are you alright?!
Oops, she can't hold out?\nHey! Adventurer! Let's hurry!!
The crystals that were covering up the trunk of\nCersier's tree got cracked and scattered when\nyou sprayed Parasiverto!
Yes!
My sister will be safe...\nAdventurer, thank you so... Ah?!
Who broke my seal?!
I almost take her life and draw nutrition!\nHow dare you futile humans!\nI'll never forgive you!!
So, this one was weakening the tree with crystals!
Aaalright! Take it down and enjoy Hanami!!
Ug... Ugg... N-Not yet...\nThere are more... beasts of seal like me...\nGba......
Adventurer, everyone, thank you so much.\nIt's not something great but please accept this...
Beautiful, isn't it?\nCersier's Yozakura is one of the most beautiful\nthings that illuminate the world of night.
Now it's all settled! Good work everyone!\nIs the spirit of the Sakura tree happy?\n...Oh, great! Our efforts were rewarded, right?
Well, it's really beautiful... Sherry's Sakura\ntree was beautiful as well but the cherry blossoms\nappearing in the darkness are breathtaking...
Yeah! Let's enjoy Hanami!!\nParty time! Let's drink!\nHey, adventurer, join us!
Whoa? You look worried.\nIt's not like you...
Well, I'm worried that the beasts like that might\naim at this tree like Sherry's tree...
...It's true that I was attacked by the crystals\nmany times even after you helped me...
Fortunately, everyone came to save me every time.\nBut I know they cannot always come to help me...
Plus, my little sister is troubling you already.\nSo, I can't be another burden on you...
What are you saying?!\nNow that we've known the situation, we are\ndetermined to protect you forever!!
What?!
Of course! Now we know that such a beautiful\nYozakura tree exists, so we can't leave it.\nYou're gonna help us, adventurer, right?
Meh, so many nice people...\nWell, I guess I'm affected much by them.\nHeh heh.
Everyone...
I don't know how to say thank you enough...\nI appreciate it!
Alright, let's stop the pessimistic talk in\nfront of such a beautiful Yozakura! Let's enjoy\nwatching it to our hearts' content! Come on, guys!
Hey, hey, adventurer! Where are you goin'?!\n...What? You're going back to an adventure?\nYou're the life of this party, you know?!
Ha ha ha, you can't run away from me.\nCome here! Let the party begin!
Oh, adventurer! You came at just the right time...
Yes, it happened again as you can see.\nI'm afraid to ask but could you get rid of the\ncrystals with Parasiverto?
I don't think I can't return anything much but\nI'll try. So, please.
Hey! I knew you were here already!
Everyone! You kindly came to help me again?!
We became worried and decided to visit here.\nI knew it happened again...
Let's remove the crystals right now.\nVirgo?
Yea, I have Parasiverto.\nWe can begin any time.
Oh... Adventurer, Virgo.\nThank you so much!
Anyway, let's use Parasiverto first.\nStep back...
W-What?!
It's you again!!
How many times are you going to interrupt us?!\nYou want a piece of me, huh?!
Looks like we have to deal with it before that...\nOkay! Let's finish this in a flash!!
Ug...Ggg... You can never touch...\nmy kins...
Phew. Good work...
Anyway, the rest is to remove the crystals.
Okay, let's get back to the Yozakura tree...\nShe might be in danger. We don't have time to\nhave a rest now...
Welcome back! I'm happy to see you're safe,\neveryone. I knew you would be alright but\nI couldn't stop being worried about you...
No worries.\nWe can break down the crystals in a minute!
Please be careful. The monster should appear\nwhen you break the crystals...
We're all set!! What, adventurer?\n...I know. Keep your guard up, too!
Okay! They're broken!!
Watch out!
It's coming!!
Y-You broke the crystals again!\nI won't forgive you...! I never forgive you!!
It's coming! Take your weapons!!
Ug... Ugg... N-Not yet...\nThere are more... beasts of seal like me...\nGba......
Adventurer, everyone, thank you so much.\nIt's not something great but please accept this...
Wow, it's spectacular no matter how many times\nI see it!
It looks something like an illusion...
Great... I feel as if it was showing gratitude.\nI'm kinda happy...
Great job. That was tough but we I watch such a\nbeautiful thing. My effort was rewarded I guess...
Adventurer, Virgo, everyone, thank you.
I'm sorry for troubling you but I hope you can\nsave us again from now on.
Don't worry about the future!! Instead, allow us\nto have a under your trees!\nAlright, guys! Prepare for the party!!
Hey, hey, adventurer! Where are you goin'?!\n...What? You're going back to an adventure?\nYou're the life of this party, you know?!
Oh, adventurer. Me and Cersier can bloom thanks\nto your help. Thank you so much.
Oh, adventurer. Look, is it blooming beautifully?\nWhat? Ah, yes. I'm worried that the crystals\nmight appear again...
I'll do my best to bloom the flowers for people.\nPlease enjoy watching them.
Hey, it's you!! Sit down here and have a drink...\nThis Yozakura bloomed with your help.\nYou must enjoy this, right?
It's really amazing... Let's drive off the crystal\nmonsters so we can enjoy watching this beautiful\nscenery! Bwa ha ha!
Are you having fun? It was lucky that you could\ntalk with the spirits. We would've just passed by\nthem without you not knowing the situation.
By the way, I wonder what the monsters made of\ncrystals are. We don't know where they're coming\nfrom...
Hey, good adventurer.\nI'm totally exhausted thanks to the tough job that\nyou've brought to us.
You know, I don't wanna work for nothing.\n...Well, this Yozakura isn't bad.\nYa. It's not bad...
